messages.message: Hi! Welcome to Nimbus Telecom. I'm Ravi. How can I help you today? 😊
Hey Ravi. I'm James Nair. I'm really fed up with the constant drops in my connection. It's unusable.
I'm sorry to hear that you're experiencing connection issues, James. I can certainly look into this for you. Could you please provide your account number and date of birth for verification?
Sure. Account number is 42809053 and my DOB is 09/09/1977.
Thank you. I've accessed your account. I see you're at 95 MG Road. Is that correct?
Yeah, that's right. Look, I've had enough. I just want to cancel my service now.
I'm sorry to see you go. I can help you with that request. I'll go ahead and process the cancellation request for your account.
Fine. Just make sure it's done. My phone is 94473 91878 and my email is james.49@examplemail.com if you need to send confirmation.
I've noted those details. However, I'm seeing a system error on my end that's preventing me from completing the cancellation right now.
I'll need to escalate this to my supervisor to get the account closed properly.
Are you kidding me?? I just want to leave and you can't even do a simple cancellation! This is ridiculous!
I apologize for the frustration. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I've escalated the request to the supervisor team, and they will handle the final steps. Goodbye!
